product.title: Paris in a Day with Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame & Cruise

description.text: Discover Paris's iconic landmarks in a single day with a small group and a knowledgeable local guide. Skip the lines at the Louvre Museum for an immersive art experience and see the famous Mona Lisa. Stops include Louvre Museum, Montmartre, Ile de la Cité, Trocadéro, Eiffel Tower, Seine River. Explore Montmartre and Ile de la Cité on guided walks and enjoy views of the Eiffel Tower from Trocadero Square. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Louvre Museum, Montmartre, Ile de la Cité, Trocadéro that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
